about.heading: About me
paragraphs: Hey, I'm Shreehari, a computer science student exploring the intersection of technology and astrophysics. I'm interested in full-stack development, Theoretical Physics and computational astrophysics, and I enjoy discovering how programming and mathematics can help us understand the universe.

I'm constantly learning, experimenting with new ideas, and building my technical foundation. My goal is to contribute to meaningful projects in technology and, eventually, explore the universe through computational science.
